_comment: Scoped to the correctness-critical subsystems (compiler pipeline, policy engine, privacy/PII, IR schema) rather than the whole package — full-repo mutation runs are slow and this is a first pass. Score is informational only (break: null) until a baseline is established; do not treat a low score as a CI failure yet.
_inPlace_comment: inPlace is required because compile.test.ts reads fixtures from ../test-fixtures (outside this package) — Stryker's default sandbox copy only includes packages/core, so those fixture paths break inside it. inPlace mutates sources directly and restores them on exit; if a run is ever killed hard, `git checkout -- src` restores.
